Role Overview 🚀
Uncapped lends working capital to e-commerce sellers across the UK, US and Canada. Some of that business comes through partners: credit brokers, affiliates, agencies, software companies and embedded platforms who introduce sellers to us. Brokers are our largest partner group.

If you want a channel that is genuinely yours to run, it is.

We leverage multiple data sources and use cutting-edge models to make credit decisions faster and safer. We work with some of the largest global e-commerce platforms - including Amazon and Walmart - and strive to be the best alternative lender globally.

About the Company 

In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs-by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects. 

Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations. 

KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

 

About the Role

GrainLab is KoBold's mineral grain identification lab in Sudbury, Ontario. We combine microscopic and various analytical methods to find and confirm indicator minerals in heavy mineral concentrate (HMC) samples. As GrainLab's Laboratory Technician, you will keep the daily sample workflow moving. You will receive and weigh samples, log them in our laboratory information management system (LIMS), prepare imaging trays, and load samples onto our instruments to start imaging and spectroscopy runs. At the end, you will recover every grain and return each sample to its original packaging. You will report to the Sudbury Laboratory Manager and work with KoBold's hardware, data science, software team members. Your observations from the bench will directly shape mineral exploration efforts.

This role suits someone who takes pride in precise, repeatable work, who notices when a number looks wrong, and who wants to see how modern data science is changing mineral exploration.

• Maintain chain of custody from receipt to return, so every sample can be located and traced at all times.

title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
description: Background Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice. Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. At Devoted, our mission is to dramatically improve the health and well-being of our members by treating each of them like family. Devoted is growing at an incredible pace, and we are thrilled to welcome and serve every new member who joins us.
